qualification.selection: All twice-qualified goals in fixed order; no replacement and no goal-specific parameter search.
qualification.competitor: At least8/16 strict development successes qualifies preservation; otherwise retain as baseline-floor stress test.

scoring.frame: Robot frame, nonmirrored 45-degree cones; bowls identified by initial robot-relative sides.
scoring.placement: Target relation plus support/contact, gripper detached, mover speed<.02m/s, mover displacement>=.02m, goal reference maximum displacement<=.02m.
scoring.endpoint: Selected strict success termination otherwise declared horizon; each trajectory also scores the other requested goal.
scoring.reset: Reject initially true target/preservation goal, failed writes, >12mm XY settle drift, >5mm recent drift or >.03m/s final speed.
scoring.secondary: Fields named stock_* are instantaneous component diagnostics, not exact stock terminal scoring or independent episodes.
scoring.bowl_identity: Require bowl_2 to be left of bowl_1 in the robot frame after each reset, before any action.
scoring.bowl_geometry: Nesting uses the stock in_opentop_container predicate plus contact, detachment, stable dwell, intended movement, and reference preservation. All wording explicitly requests containment, not merely support above.

adaptation.source_selection: Measured first mover-contact events aligned to policy decisions. Precontact is the decision immediately before the grasp chunk; for never-grasped original failures use the last noncontact decision. A never-grasped failure contributes a failure-local pre-contact decision, not demonstrated approach motion. Failed original trajectories are prioritized, then successful teacher trajectories. Grasp is the decision whose chunk first establishes contact. Transport is the first decision starting with the mover held >=25mm above reset height. Six distinct source episodes per phase from initial qualification; two per phase from the independent repeat qualify as validation. Earliest source slots win ties. No duplicate input decisions or heldout inputs.
adaptation.annotation: Simulator mover-gripper contact and height are privileged phase-selection information, disclosed; no human action labels.
adaptation.missing_phase: Stop that construction with evidence; no time-fraction fallback or replacement goal.

heldout.selection: All candidates sealed together before testing; no test-based tuning, reruns, or goal replacement.

preflight.scope: All three scenes, development and heldout geometry. Each scene/split gets one process, no retry.
